newsitem.title: CANADA: Crank threatens to bomb Canadian leader's house.
newsitem.headline: Crank threatens to bomb Canadian leader's house.

text.p: A crank caller claimed he had delivered a bomb to the residence of Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien, police said on Thursday.

"We are quite satisfied that the security of the prime minister was not jeopardised," said Sergeant Andre Guertin of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP), the federal police force, adding that no bomb was found after Wednesday's call.
An RCMP statement said: "The caller is known to the RCMP, who is investigating this matter."

Guertin said the caller was not Andre Dallaire, a Quebec man who entered the prime minister's residence with a knife after Quebec separatists lost an independence referendum last October. Dallaire has since been freed.
